text:
maia: Heads up — SDK 0.15 rollout to canary started ~5m ago. We're seeing multiple client handshake failures on streaming connections from the canary fleet. Error looks like `handshake: incompatible-proto`.

deploy-bot: Deploy kickoff | sha=ab9f3c | target=dedicated-canary | started by @maia

alex: seeing 502s from the gateway to runtime on canary nodes, looks like sudden spike after first 10% of rollout.

owen: paging oncall — I'm taking this. Assigning incident page.

jess: adding quick triage: probable cause is the streaming client wire version bump in SDK 0.15.0 — server still accepts the older framing. Need immediate mitigation until we can rollback or add compatibility layer.

maia: customer impact: several customers reported partial stream disconnects when using `client.stream()` in SDK 0.15. Tokenized responses still work on rest endpoints. Estimate affected sessions ~1200 in last 10m, mostly low-latency customers in us-west.

support-bot: Customer ticket alert: #C-9182 from AcmeAnalytics — "streams disconnect immediately after connect" — created 3m ago.

owen: quick options: 1) kill feature flag for SDK-0.15-streaming -> prevents clients advertising new wire protocol, 2) rollback canary to 0.14, 3) hotfix server to accept both framing versions. Which is fastest?

jess: flag kill is fastest. I'm toggling the flag now: `/ff kill sdk_streaming_v2` — will post status.

maia: +1 to flag kill. Notify support and add temporary note to status page.

jess: `> feature-flag sdk_streaming_v2=off`

deploy-bot: feature-flag change applied | key=sdk_streaming_v2 | value=off | by=jess | at=1752001302

alex: after flag toggle, telemetry shows handshake failures dropping. error-rate from 18% -> 1.2% in the canary window. Looks like clients that already negotiated v2 still fail, but new connects use v1 now.

maia: good. can we still have lingering users? What's the rollback plan if this reappears?

owen: plan B: full canary rollback to 0.14 build `release/0.14.9` if failures don't drop to <1% in next 10m. Rollback command below.

jess: rollback command (dry-run):
```
# rollback canary
kubectl set image deployment/redwood-runtime canary=redwood/runtime:0.14.9 --namespace=canary
kubectl rollout status deployment/redwood-runtime --namespace=canary
```

maia: coordinate with support: please message impacted customers with note that we're mitigating and give ETA 30m.

support-bot: outgoing notice queued for #C-9182, #C-9191, #C-9198.

alex: also flagging the SDK release PR that changed the streaming frame header. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/332

jess: assigning @alex and @owen to postmortem if this is due to API contract incompat. We'll need a minimal changelog and a revert PR if necessary.

owen: oncall handoff: I'm staying on until stable. Next oncall (tue) @lina — pinging now in case of extended work.

maia: incident severity update: S2 -> reducing to S3 as customer impact is limited and flag killed. We'll continue monitoring for 1h and then close.

deploy-bot: incident-note appended | id=INC-1752001234 | status=mitigated | by=deploy-bot

jess: followups: 1) patch server for dual-protocol support, 2) add integration test to SDK that tests backward compat on streaming, 3) release note and clear migration path in SDK docs.

alex: logging info to postmortem thread. grabbing request traces for affected customer sessions.

maia: thanks everyone. I'll start the postmortem draft after we confirm telemetry stable. If anything changes, update this thread.
